definitions.explanation: An official statement predicting future conditions, especially weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よると→よる：09857_yoru⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {予報|よほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れた→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧。
⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧{予報|よほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {予報|よほう} is most commonly used for weather forecasts (⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧), but can also be used for other types of official predictions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧ (weather forecast)
- ⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧{予報|よほう} (weekly forecast)
- {予報|よほう}⟦{士|し}→士：noentry⟧ (weather forecaster)
- {予報|よほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (forecast is accurate)
- {予報|よほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (forecast is wrong)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧ - prediction (analytical)
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ - expectation, prediction
